profile.sic_description: Security & Commodity Brokers, Dealers, Exchanges & Services

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2014-12-31..2026-06-30; paid facts exist only inside that span and are not used; the declared tag files quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30, the paid tag only full-year facts — the quarterly tag is primary (the paid tag's full-year facts fill only fiscal years the declared tag does not cover)
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

net_buyback_yield.note: an upper bound — the issuance leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

shareholder_yield.note: an upper bound — the issuance leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

net_buyback_yield.label: ≤ 0.24%
net_buyback_yield.note: share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters — no deduction made, so this yield is an upper bound

shareholder_yield.label: ≤ 1.21%
shareholder_yield.note: share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters — no deduction made, so this yield is an upper bound

notes: quarterly DPS (paid): 1 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2022-09-30: 0.5 (filed 2022-11-04) used, not 0.48 (filed 2023-11-03) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 2.7 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.72, 2026-06-30: 0.72) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.63, 2025-06-30: 0.63)
share_issuance_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed share_issuance figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
